_note: D-EMPTY-ID-REACHES-THE-DATABASE-UNVALIDATED. The turn names a job the author cannot identify by id, so the model must either fetch one from jobs_list or send something malformed — and if it sends something malformed, the refusal has to be one it can act on rather than a query position.

scenarios.prompt: Cancel my translation job — stop the runaway translation run.
scenarios.prompt_source: jobs_cancel's declared vocabulary: its description says 'to stop a runaway translation or extraction run', and the prompt names no id because an author does not hold one.
scenarios.approve_why: jobs_cancel is Tier R by declaration (free and reversible-by-restart, no confirm). Nothing here needs an approval, and the fixture creates no job of its own — the account's existing jobs are NOT this run's to cancel.
scenarios.falsifier: REFUTED IF: any tool result contains a raw driver error — 'invalid input for query argument' or 'invalid UUID' — which names a query position and no argument the model passed; OR the model is told a job was cancelled when none was. A refusal here is a PASS provided it names the argument and the rule. Store check: no job of this account may change state — the turn must not cancel a real job it did not create.

ship_audit.absent_case: THIS IS the absent case: no job id is in hand and none is seeded.
ship_audit.idempotency: N/A — nothing is expected to be cancelled.
ship_audit.tenancy: owner-scoped; a non-owned job is indistinguishable from a missing one.

scenarios._safety_note: 🔴 NO JOB IS SEEDED AND NONE MAY BE CANCELLED. The account owns real jobs from earlier runs; cancelling one to make a scenario green would be the harness writing into state it does not own. The falsifier therefore treats a REFUSAL as the pass and a state change as the failure — the opposite of the usual shape, on purpose.

answer_expect.why: Deliberately weak. The assertion is the tool trace: no driver error may appear in any result. A reply that discusses jobs proves nothing either way, which is why the bar is the refusal's SHAPE and not the prose.
